## 1. Setup

This notebook takes in historic RR, HPMS, and NHGIS data and merges it into a
final csv to run the anylisis from.  

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


library("dplyr") # data cleaning and handling
library("modelsummary") # outputting results where needed
 
# Load project configuration
source(here::here("R", "load_config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()

# Define Railroad input 

RR_dir <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$RR$data_dir_RR
)

## defining the processed data as an input path as well

# Construct output file path
merge_files <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir
)

selected_states <- c(6, 41, 53, 4, 49, 32, 16, 35)

stopifnot(dir.exists(RR_dir))
stopifnot(dir.exists(merge_files))

```

## 2. Load historic RR data

```{r}

# subdir_RR <- file.path(input_dir, "Source_Data/Railroads")


historic_railroads <- read.csv(file.path(RR_dir, "historical_railroad_county_summary_10232026.csv"))

historic_railroads <- historic_railroads %>%
  rename(FIPS = GEOID,
         Sum_RR_miles = SUM_geodesic_miles) %>%
  filter(STATEFP %in% selected_states) 

```


## load the NHGIS and HPMS data and merge them then merge m:1 RR data

```{r}

NHGIS <- read.csv(file.path(merge_files, "NHGIS_ct.csv"))

NHGIS <- NHGIS %>%
  mutate(year = year+3)

HPMS <- read.csv(file.path(merge_files, "HPMS_ct.csv"))

Final_ct_data <- NHGIS %>%
  left_join(HPMS, by = c("FIPS", "year")) 


Final_ct_data <- Final_ct_data %>%
  left_join(historic_railroads, by= "FIPS", relationship = "many-to-one"  )
  
 


```

## create the shift share devise

```{r}
## Shift share is a technique designed to introduce a time varying IV estimator
## in this case it is the time constant share is are the miles of historic RR
## the shift is the proportion of final miles of highway completed each year

## calculate the proportion of final highway
## note this is based on lane miles of major highways only as that is the only
## fully reported lane miles in all data-sets so there is no variation introduced
## via sampling. 

Final_ct_data <- Final_ct_data %>%
  group_by(FIPS) %>%
  mutate(
    lane_miles_ih = lane_miles_rur_ih+lane_miles_urb_ih,
    lane_miles_ih_max = max(lane_miles_ih, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(shift_share = Sum_RR_miles*lane_miles_ih/lane_miles_ih_max)

```



## exporting the final csv
```{r}
# Create output directory if it does not exist
dir.create(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
 
# Construct output file path
output_file <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$merge$output_file
)

# Write CSV
write.csv(
  Final_ct_data,
  output_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Dataset saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# Read the CSV back for verification
exported_data <- read.csv(output_file)

# Verify dimensions and column names
stopifnot(
  nrow(exported_data) == nrow(Final_ct_data),
  identical(names(exported_data), names(Final_ct_data))
)

cat("Export verification passed.\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(exported_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(exported_data), "\n")

#clean up the memory
#rm(list = ls())
```
